当前财务影响及资产负债调整风险

Disclosure of current financial effects of material risks and opportunities on financial position, financial performance and cash flows and material risks and opportunities for which there is significant risk of material adjustment within next annual reporting period to carrying amounts of assets and liabilities reported in related financial statements。当前财务影响及资产负债调整风险。影响与财务风险机会分开，当前与未来财务效果分开；集团业务背景不自动适用于子公司或特定场址。
